text: Ha can you believe we actually did it, we made it through the storm, wind howling, rain lashing, I thought we'd never see the sun again there were nights, nights I cried myself to sleep whispering is anyone even out there but then you showed up you smiled and suddenly the world wasn't so dark I felt seen, understood then build.Remember that silly dance in the kitchen with burnt pancakes, oh we were a mess, but now now you've gone, the silence is deafening, I miss you every single day but I carry you with me in every laugh every tear every quiet moment and I'll keep going because that's what you would want always.
